reasoning_trace: The query object is a small, hand-formed bowl or cup with uneven, textured, painted surfaces. The gecko gripper relies on rigid, flat, parallel pads engaging smoothly with opposing object walls to generate high dry adhesion. Because the object exhibits non-uniform curvature and a potentially porous or rough painted coating, broad uniform contact cannot form, leading to low gecko adhesion compatibility. Consequently, a higher normal force is required to compensate for the weak dry-adhesion contribution and rely more on limited frictional support to securely lift the object without exceeding the 8 N actuator limit.
